Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (December 1, 2022, from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3687223488 Description: For the non-exclusive supply and delivery of Aqua Ammonia for the City of Toronto's Water Division from January 1, 2023, to September 30, 2023, with the option to renew the Contract for four (4) additional and separate one (1) year periods at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval.
